decisions.reason: The source establishes how to provision a new MeetAlfred campaign and its Zap but does not change the required HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred lead synchronization behavior.
The source does not resume or modify the deferred automated email campaign requirement.
Creating a MeetAlfred campaign and updating its Zap does not change the requirement to connect the campaign email account to MeetAlfred.
The source describes general campaign provisioning and does not change silent-lead selection, follow-up list handling, or former-campaign cleanup rules.
The campaign provisioning method does not affect how MeetAlfred replies are represented in HubSpot.
The source neither changes the MeetAlfred subscription plan nor otherwise modifies account setup requirements.
Creating a new campaign and copying a Zap is compatible with preserving existing campaigns and does not alter that constraint.
Copying and publishing a Zap does not change the Zapier account, subscription tier, or add-on requirements.
The source does not authorize use of existing MeetAlfred leads for testing or otherwise change the test-isolation constraint.
The source does not identify a LinkedIn campaign or resume the deferred LinkedIn campaign automation requirement.
The new MeetAlfred campaign and copied Zap do not change the campaign-domain email account requirement.
The source does not change CRM list grouping or the rule for moving silent leads into a follow-up list.
